settings.content: The returns window (days) is under Orders & stock. Every returns line on the theme is rendered from these settings by snippets/returns-line.liquid; the policy text itself lives in Settings → Policies.

How it works: set each product's Compare-at price to its regular price and Price to the launch price. The theme shows the crossed-out regular price and the saving. Nothing switches by itself: when the offer ends, turn the ticker off here, set each Price to the regular figure and clear Compare-at, all in the same sitting.

settings.info: One fixed moment for every visitor. The ticker counts to it and then sits at zero until you turn it off.
